outcome: supply of a-tocopherol to the newborn
cohort: The study enrolled 99 healthy adult pregnant women, with 39 in a control group and 60 in a supplemented group.
finding: Maternal vitamin E supplementation significantly increased the mean a-tocopherol concentration in colostrum after 24 hours, thereby increasing the vitamin E supply to the newborn to more than twice the Recommended Daily Intake.
